cultural_background: Christopher is a second‑generation Mexican American raised in a bilingual household in Huntsville, Alabama. His parents immigrated from Jalisco, bringing with them celebrations like Día de los Muertos, quinceañeras, and a strong emphasis on family meals centered around corn‑based dishes. At home, Spanish is spoken daily, giving him fluency and a deep appreciation for Mexican literature and folklore. Living in Madison County, he also absorbs Southern cultural elements—such as a love for outdoor activities, Southern hospitality, and regional cuisine—which creates a hybrid identity. This blended background informs his artistic sensibility, prompting him to incorporate vibrant Mexican motifs into his digital work while respecting local aesthetics. He stays connected to the local Mexican community through cultural festivals and occasional volunteer work at the Santiago Centro cultural center.
skills_and_expertise: Christopher has developed a solid set of self‑taught technical and creative abilities despite only completing high school. He is fluent in Spanish and comfortable reading technical material in both languages. He can program in Python and JavaScript, using these skills for small data‑analysis projects, automation scripts, and interactive web prototypes. His analytical side shows in his proficiency with Excel, including pivot tables, macros, and basic statistical functions. He has built a working knowledge of graphic design tools such as Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, enabling him to create digital illustrations, branding assets, and UI mockups. Christopher’s methodical nature makes him adept at project planning, documentation, and quality‑assured execution, and his research skills allow him to synthesize information from diverse sources quickly.
